errors.text_span: Der Nickelimport beläuft sich auf 24,7 % im Jahr 2021, auf 25,1 % im Jahr 2022
errors.evidence: Description states 24.7% in 2021 and 25.1% in 2022 for Nickel imports in Germany. Figure shows these as 25.1% (2021) and 24.7% (2022).
The machine-generated description does not mention the chart's focus on Russian industrial raw material imports.
